definitions.explanation: The act of combining multiple ingredients or substances in specific proportions to create a mixture, compound, or preparation. Used for medicines, paints, chemicals, and in gaming contexts for crafting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調合|ちょうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調合|ちょうごう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{好|す}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色合|いろあ}い→色合い：13950_iroai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I mixed colors to create the shade I wanted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調合|ちょうごう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The pharmacist compounded the medicine based on the prescription.

notes:
Composed of {調|ちょう} (regulate, adjust) + ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (combine, mix). Originally a pharmaceutical term, now used broadly for any careful mixing of ingredients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調合|ちょうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compound medicine
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{調合|ちょうごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mix colors/paints
- {調合|ちょうごう}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: pre-mixed, already compounded
- {調合|ちょうごう}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: mixing ratio

MODERN USAGE:
Popular in video game contexts, especially RPGs, where players {調合|ちょうごう} items (craft potions, mix ingredients). This has made the word familiar to younger generations through gaming.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧: blending, formulation — emphasizes the proportions and recipe
- ⟦{混合|こんごう}→混合：04154_kongou⟧: mixing — more general, any combining of substances
- ⟦{調剤|ちょうざい}→調剤：18821_chouzai⟧: dispensing (medicine) — specifically pharmaceutical preparation
